summary: Frontend-only verification of admin photo gallery visibility on /wedding/[clientId]. Logged in as admin@wedding.fr / Admin13! via /auth/login, navigated to /wedding/hanifa-et-dali. The wedding loads as unlocked for admin, and the new 'Galerie photo (Admin)' button (testID=wedding-photos-btn) is rendered with the admin-specific label and subtitle ('Voir les photos uploadees - Mode admin'). Tapping it navigates to /photos/hanifa-et-dali, which renders the photo gallery showing the expected 'Aucune photo disponible' empty state with NO 'Premium required' gate. The fix works as intended end-to-end.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '[expo-av]: Expo AV has been deprecated and will be removed in SDK 54. Use the expo-audio and expo-video packages.' Not blocking this fix, but should be migrated.

action_items: Optional/not related to this fix: migrate from expo-av to expo-audio / expo-video before SDK 54 to avoid deprecation removal.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix in /app/frontend/app/wedding/[clientId].tsx lines 330-348 is correct: condition (wedding.is_my_wedding || user?.is_admin) gates the photo gallery entry, label adapts to 'Galerie photo (Admin)' when admin is not the owner. user comes from useAuth() (line 81) and is_admin is defined on the User type in AuthContext.tsx (line 10).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login flow via /auth/login uses testIDs login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn. After login admin lands on /home. /wedding/hanifa-et-dali is unlocked for admin and exposes wedding-photos-btn. Photos screen at /photos/hanifa-et-dali bypasses premium gate for admin (backend /app/backend/photos.py line 128).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: button only rendered when wedding.is_my_wedding was true; admins do not own weddings so the button was hidden. Fix applies an OR with user?.is_admin and adapts the label/subtitle when admin is viewing a non-owned wedding. Verified visible and functional in mobile viewport (390x844) on web preview.
